entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return these shoes I just got.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They give me blisters. So I guess it's a 'preference' for not having my feet torn up.

I completely understand, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I'm sorry to hear they weren't a good fit. I see here on your account you received them about three days ago, is that right?

Okay. Well, the good news is you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for apparel and shoes. We can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you. Have the cleats been installed or have the shoes been used extensively outdoors?
I tried them on my indoor trainer. The cleats were on them for about ten minutes. They're not dirty.

That's perfectly fine. I'm processing that return for you now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your file. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued.
Alright. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
I doubt it. That was all.
Okay. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope we can find a better-fitting product for you in the future. Have a good day.
